title: Create a meeting
summary: A new meeting receives an ID and can be retrieved after creation.
prerequisites: Review the imported contracts for this behavior before implementation; source descriptions can differ from the contract routes.
acceptance: Creating a meeting returns 201, an ID, source type, and Location header.
The created meeting can be retrieved after a new request.
Unauthenticated creation and retrieval are rejected.
Repeating a creation request with the same idempotency key returns the original result.

title: List meetings
summary: Meetings can be browsed and filtered without loading every detail.
prerequisites: Review the imported contracts for this behavior before implementation; source descriptions can differ from the contract routes.
acceptance: The list is paginated and respects the source_type filter.

title: Update meeting details
summary: Changes to the title or notes survive a reload.
prerequisites: Review the imported contracts for this behavior before implementation; source descriptions can differ from the contract routes.
acceptance: A saved title or notes update is returned by the next read.
Connected subscribers receive the corresponding meeting change event.

title: Delete a meeting
summary: Deleting a meeting removes it and notifies connected clients.
prerequisites: Review the imported contracts for this behavior before implementation; source descriptions can differ from the contract routes.
acceptance: Deleting an eligible meeting returns 204 and emits a meeting deletion event.

title: Accept a recording upload
summary: A valid recording is stored in a standard audio format and queued for transcription.
prerequisites: Review the imported contracts for this behavior before implementation; source descriptions can differ from the contract routes.
acceptance: Valid audio produces a standardized stored file and a durable transcription request.
Invalid file content is rejected with 415; files beyond the size or duration limit are rejected with 413.
A meeting with an existing audio object rejects another upload with 409.

title: Report processing progress
summary: Clients can read progress and receive updates when processing changes state.
prerequisites: Review the imported contracts for this behavior before implementation; source descriptions can differ from the contract routes.
acceptance: The status API validates transitions and records the status and message in history.
The new progress state can be read and is announced to subscribers.
Service-authenticated status write-back succeeds.

title: Save and retrieve the final transcript
summary: A complete transcript replaces the previous version atomically and can be read back.
prerequisites: Review the imported contracts for this behavior before implementation; source descriptions can differ from the contract routes.
acceptance: Replacing a transcript leaves exactly the submitted segments, with no partial intermediate version.
The final segments can be read back with pagination and time filters.
Subscribers receive TranscriptRevisedEvent.

title: Save and retrieve meeting insights
summary: A summary, topics, and talking points are stored together and published to connected clients.
prerequisites: Review the imported contracts for this behavior before implementation; source descriptions can differ from the contract routes.
acceptance: The submitted summary, headline, topics, and talking points can be read back together.
Replacement is atomic and emits SynthesisUpdatedEvent.

title: Create and retrieve action items
summary: User and service requests can create action items and retrieve them across meetings.
prerequisites: Review the imported contracts for this behavior before implementation; source descriptions can differ from the contract routes.
acceptance: A created action item can be retrieved by ID and in the appropriate meeting or filtered global list.
Creation emits the corresponding task change event.

title: Edit and delete action items
summary: User edits take ownership of generated items, and deletions remove their children.
prerequisites: Review the imported contracts for this behavior before implementation; source descriptions can differ from the contract routes.
acceptance: Editing a generated item changes its source to user.
Deleting a task removes its subtasks and emits a change event.

title: Add and retrieve subtasks
summary: An action item can contain smaller items that can be retrieved from its API.
prerequisites: Review the imported contracts for this behavior before implementation; source descriptions can differ from the contract routes.
acceptance: A subtask created for a task is returned by that task’s subtask endpoint.

title: Replace generated action items safely
summary: New machine-generated results replace older results while preserving user-owned items.
prerequisites: Review the imported contracts for this behavior before implementation; source descriptions can differ from the contract routes.
acceptance: Reconciliation preserves user-created and user-edited items.
Unedited generated items missing from the replacement set are removed.

title: Transcribe an uploaded recording
summary: An accepted job produces a final transcript once, with observable progress and failure status.
acceptance: A job transitions to transcribing and writes final transcript segments to Core.
A permanent transcription failure records failed status with a readable message.
Duplicate message deliveries or run requests do not repeat transcript write-back.

title: Extract meeting insights
summary: A final transcript produces a summary and action items, including valid empty results.

title: Recover from insight generation failures
summary: Temporary failures retry synthesis without repeating transcription; exhausted retries leave readable partial results.

title: Choose and upload a recording
summary: A user selects an audio file and sees its upload progress.

title: Show processing progress
summary: The meeting shows current progress or a useful error, including after a page reload.

title: Browse recorded meetings
summary: Meeting cards show the title, date, attendees, source, and current processing state.

title: Search recorded meetings
summary: Users can narrow their meeting list by title or headline and clear the search.

title: Rename a meeting
summary: A user can edit a meeting title and recover the previous value if saving fails.

title: Delete a recorded meeting
summary: A user can confirm or cancel deletion and understands when an active recording prevents it.

title: Read the meeting summary
summary: The overview shows generated insights and action items and refreshes when results arrive.

title: Read the final transcript
summary: The transcript view shows speakers, topics, and talking points and updates after a rebuild.

title: Manage action items across meetings
summary: Users can create, edit, complete, and delete items through shared task controls.

title: Find action items
summary: Users can search and filter tasks by status or assignee.

title: Manage a meeting’s action items
summary: The same task controls work within a meeting and retain that meeting’s scope.

title: Write and browse notes
summary: Users can create notes and browse cards with loading, empty, and error states.

title: Write notes for a meeting or person
summary: Notes created within a meeting or person appear in that context automatically.

title: Edit or delete a note
summary: Users can update existing notes and confirm before deleting them.

title: Find notes by text or tag
summary: Users can search note content and use tags to narrow the results.

title: Change a note’s context
summary: Users can link or unlink an existing note from a meeting or person.

title: Start a live recording

title: Stop a recording and request finalization
summary: A stop command transitions the stored session and triggers final processing.

title: Turn live audio into transcript segments
summary: Audio entering a session produces transcript segments at the Core boundary.

title: Finish a live transcription session
summary: Stopping flushes the provider’s final segments and closes the session cleanly.

title: Report a slow transcription provider
summary: Provider buffer pressure becomes an observable signal; its acceptance is deferred in the source plan.

title: Start recording from the browser
summary: The user grants microphone access and sees that recording has started.

title: Keep a local copy of live audio
summary: Audio is buffered in a worker so recording does not block the page.

title: Read a transcript while recording
summary: New transcript segments appear live with scrolling and partial-word feedback.

title: Show connection and recording health
summary: The page explains degraded recording health and handles a lost connection.

title: Stop recording and show finalization
summary: Stopping the recording opens the processing state for the final summary.

title: Store live audio durably

title: Acknowledge safely stored audio

title: Resume an interrupted recording
summary: A reconnecting client receives its missing ranges and resumes sending audio.

title: Accept recovered audio chunks

title: Inspect stored audio coverage
summary: Operators can inspect segment inventory through a service-authenticated endpoint.
prerequisites: Review the imported contracts for this behavior before implementation; source descriptions can differ from the contract routes.

title: Keep audio safe during disconnection
summary: Every recorded chunk is indexed and checksummed locally, even when the connection drops.

title: Send buffered audio without overloading the connection
summary: Audio frames are sent in order and pause under pressure while local capture continues.

title: Release audio already stored by the server
summary: Server acknowledgements remove only safely persisted chunks from the local buffer.

title: Recover audio after reconnection
summary: The browser checks stored chunks and uploads the missing ranges requested by the server.

title: Finish recovery after stopping or reloading
summary: Missing audio continues uploading after stop or page reload, with visible progress.

title: Explain recording interruptions
summary: Combined health warnings describe active problems and clear when recovery succeeds.

title: Continue transcription across audio gaps
summary: Missing sequences are counted and reported without stopping the live transcript.

title: Report audio pressure and long gaps
summary: Queue recovery and long audio gaps produce health signals without stopping insights.

title: Restore transcription context after reconnecting
summary: A resumed session restores speaker state and recent transcript context before processing new audio.

title: Save live meeting notes
summary: Note updates persist and notify connected clients.
scope: Persist the notes field through PATCH /meetings/{id}.
Broadcast EntityChangedEvent for the updated meeting.

title: Autosave notes while recording
summary: Typed notes save after a pause and return when the page is refreshed.
scope: Use the shared note editor during recording.
Debounce PATCH requests and restore saved notes after refresh.

title: Read notes after recording
summary: The finalized meeting retains notes written during recording.
scope: Display saved notes in finalized meeting detail using the shared note components.

title: Publish live talking points

scope: Accept ML write-back through POST /meetings/{id}/talking-points.
Persist the point and broadcast TalkingPointEvent.

title: Replace provisional talking points
summary: Final synthesis replaces provisional talking points and notifies subscribers.
scope: Replace points through PUT /meetings/{id}/synthesis and emit SynthesisUpdatedEvent.

title: Extract talking points during recording

scope: Run insight extraction after the configured transcript segment batch.
Emit TalkingPointProducedEvent for the resulting points.

title: Produce final talking points

title: Read provisional talking points

scope: Render the recording view’s draft talking-points panel from live events.

title: Refresh talking points after finalization
summary: Provisional points are replaced when the final synthesis arrives.
scope: On SynthesisUpdatedEvent, fetch the final set and remove provisional labels.

title: Publish action items during recording
summary: Live action items carry ownership information and notify subscribers.
scope: Track source ownership as user or system.
Publish TaskEvent when a live action item arrives.

title: Reconcile final action items
summary: Final machine results preserve user-created and user-edited items.
scope: PUT /meetings/{id}/tasks/system replaces unedited system items while preserving user-owned items.

title: Extract action items during recording
summary: The live insight pipeline emits provisional task candidates.

title: Assign people to transcript speakers

Apply assignments optimistically to transcript rows.
